message.resonantinduction.tesla.status: Tesla tower: height %s, range %s, charge %s, received %s (of %s each), colour %s, receive %s, attack %s, %s
message.resonantinduction.entangler.mark: Marked Tesla tower at [%s, %s, %s]. Use on another tower to link.
message.resonantinduction.entangler.link: Linked with the tower at [%s, %s, %s] in %s
message.resonantinduction.entangler.fail: Could not link: the marked device is gone, of another kind, or out of reach
tooltip.resonantinduction.entangler.empt: Use on a Tesla tower or levitator to mark it, then on another to link them
jei.resonantinduction.tesla: Stack Tesla Coils into a tower; each coil above the first adds 4 blocks of range (up to 50). Power the bottom coil from any side but the top: the tower beams energy to other towers of two or more coils within range, which push it into machines next to their bottom coil. Dye a tower to give it a frequency; light blue (the default) talks to every colour. Empty hand: toggle receiving. Redstone dust: toggle zapping mobs in the arcs. A redstone signal stops a tower sending. Sneak-use with an empty hand shows the tower's status.
jei.resonantinduction.quantum_entangler: Use on one Tesla tower, then another, to link them: linked towers send only to each other, even across dimensions (the far end's chunk must be loaded). Also links a pushing and a pulling Electromagnetic Levitator. Sneak-use a device to unlink it.
message.resonantinduction.levitator.pull: Levitator: pulling items into the inventory
message.resonantinduction.levitator.push: Levitator: pushing items out along the beam
jei.resonantinduction.levitator: Place on the side of an inventory. In pull mode (default) it puts items that reach it into the inventory. Sneak-use with an empty hand to switch to push mode: it takes items out one at a time and carries them along its beam to a levitator facing it, up to 40 blocks away. Link a pushing and a pulling levitator with a Quantum Entangler to carry items around corners (up to 200 blocks). Dye changes the beam colour; a redstone signal turns it off.
tooltip.resonantinduction.glyph: Fill all eight corners of a block with glyphs to make a Quantum Gate
jei.resonantinduction.glyph_nought: Each glyph fills one corner of a block; fill all eight corners to make a Quantum Gate. The order of the glyphs sets its frequency. Gates on the same frequency, in any dimension, teleport mobs and items that land on them to another gate on that frequency. Players go by sneaking on a gate or sneak-using it with an empty hand. They also share one item slot and a one-bucket fluid tank that hoppers and pipes can use from every side.

jei.resonantinduction.charger: Place on any face of a block and put a chargeable item on it (right-click with the item; empty hand takes it back). Power fed into the charger goes straight into the item. Hoppers and pipes can load it too.
jei.resonantinduction.mining_laser: Hold use to fire. Sneak-use switches mode. Remove: holding the beam on a block for 15 ticks cuts it out (wood, plants and wool catch fire, TNT is lit). Smelt: sand to glass, cobblestone to stone, ice to water, obsidian to lava; flammable blocks burn. Damage: only hurts. The beam sets mobs on fire. Uses FE: charge it in a Charger.
jei.resonantinduction.copper_wire: Carries FE between machines. Place it flat on a face, or sneak to place it through the middle of a block. Wires only join wires of the same metal. Use wool to insulate (bare live wires shock), dye to recolour the insulation (insulated wires only join the same colour or white), shears to strip it, and a lever to make a switch wire that only conducts while powered by redstone.

tooltip.resonantinduction.wire.help: Sneak to place through a block; wool insulates, a lever makes a switch
jei.resonantinduction.battery: Stores FE. Batteries placed against each other merge into one bank and share their energy. Every face starts as an input; use a wrench (or sneak-use with an empty hand) on a face to switch it between input, output and off. Output faces push energy into whatever is next to them. Keeps its charge when broken, and can be charged in a Charger. Tier 2 is made from eight tier 1 batteries, tier 3 from eight tier 2.
jei.resonantinduction.solar_panel: Makes 50 FE a tick under open sky in daytime, when it is not raining. Pushes power out of every side.
jei.resonantinduction.thermopile: Makes power from hot and cold blocks touching it: water (1) or ice and snow (2) on the cold side, fire (1) or lava (2) on the hot side. Output is 15 FE a tick times (3 - the difference), when it has both. After two minutes of use the sources reach equilibrium: water boils away, ice melts, fire dies and lava cools to stone.
jei.resonantinduction.multimeter: Place on the face of a block to read it: stored energy, flow (FE/t, or the current through a wire), capacity, fluid, and the torque, speed, temperature or pressure of blocks that have them. Multimeters side by side make one big screen. Right-click for settings: it can give a redstone signal when a reading is above, below or equal to a limit. A wrench pauses it.
jei.resonantinduction.transformer: Passes power in one direction: energy entering the side that faced you when you placed it comes out of the opposite side. Right-click to switch between stepping voltage up and down; a wrench turns it, sneak + wrench changes the winding (2x, 3x, 4x). Forge Energy has no voltage, so the amount of power passing through is not changed.
jei.resonantinduction.gear_wood: Place on the face of a block. Gears side by side on the same face mesh and turn opposite ways; a gear passes its rotation to the machine it sits on, and to a gear shaft pointing into its centre. Turn one with a Hand Crank. Stone and metal gears lose less power.
jei.resonantinduction.gear_creative: Always turns at full power (for testing machines).
jei.resonantinduction.shaft_wood: Carries rotation in a straight line to more shafts, to gears facing it, and to machines at its ends. Stone and metal shafts lose less power.
jei.resonantinduction.hand_crank: Use on a gear to turn it for a second (sneak to turn the other way). Keep using it to keep things moving.
message.resonantinduction.turbine.need_3: Needs a 3x3 of the same turbine, all facing the same way, with this one in the middle
message.resonantinduction.turbine.joined: Turbines joined into one large turbine
jei.resonantinduction.motor: Turns power into rotation through its front and back faces; the other four faces take power. Sneak + wrench makes it a generator instead: it brakes the rotation it is given and puts out power. Sneak-use with an empty hand changes the gear (more torque or more speed); a wrench turns it.
jei.resonantinduction.wind_turbine_wood: Place it against a gear, shaft or machine: its back turns them. Horizontal wind turbines catch more wind the more open air is around them, the higher they are, in plains, oceans and rivers, and when it rains. A wrench on the middle of a 3x3 of the same turbine joins them into one large turbine. Storms can wreck wooden ones.
jei.resonantinduction.water_turbine_wood: Facing up or down, it lets water fall through it from above, one source block a second. Facing sideways, it is a waterwheel turned by water flowing past its sides. Its back turns gears, shafts and machines. A wrench on the middle of a 3x3 of the same turbine joins them into one large turbine.
jei.resonantinduction.wind_turbine_stone: Place it against a gear, shaft or machine: its back turns them. Horizontal wind turbines catch more wind the more open air is around them, the higher they are, in plains, oceans and rivers, and when it rains. A wrench on the middle of a 3x3 of the same turbine joins them into one large turbine.

Facing sideways, it is a waterwheel turned by water flowing past its sides. Its back turns gears, shafts and machines. A wrench on the middle of a 3x3 of the same turbine joins them into one large turbine.
tooltip.resonantinduction.dust: Sneak-use on a water cauldron to wash it into refined dust
jei.resonantinduction.mechanical_piston: Turned by gears or shafts from any side but its face. Once a turn it strikes the block in front of it: ores, stone, cobblestone and chests crack and break into their crushed products (ores into rubble) after five strikes; anything else is pushed one block forward.
jei.resonantinduction.grinding_wheel: Turned through its axle (the two sides across from where it faces). Once it has enough torque, items resting on it are ground in 20 seconds each: rubble into two dirty dust, cobblestone, gravel and glass into sand. It hurts and flings whatever else touches it.
jei.resonantinduction.mixer: Turned from above or below. Wall in its four diagonal neighbours and it stirs everything around it: dirty dust stirred over water for 12 seconds turns the water into a dust mixture, and more dust thickens it. Put a Filter under the mixture to wash it into refined dust.
jei.resonantinduction.filter: Under a dust mixture it lets it drip through as water and catches refined dust. Give it an Imprint and the items on the imprint fall through it while others stay on top (sneak + wrench inverts that).
jei.resonantinduction.millstone: Put rubble, cobblestone, gravel or glass in it and turn it with a Hand Crank; every twentieth turn grinds one.
jei.resonantinduction.imprint: Lists items for filters, sorters, detectors and manipulators. Make one in the Imprinter.
jei.resonantinduction.firebox: Burns furnace fuel (right-click it in, left-click takes it back) or a bucket of lava, and heats the block above it. A dust pile on top melts into a pool of molten metal (refined dust gives twice as much), water on top boils away, and a Hot Plate on top cooks.
jei.resonantinduction.electric_firebox: A Firebox that also burns on power from any side but the top.
jei.resonantinduction.hot_plate: Put it on a burning Firebox. Right-click a quarter of the plate to put the held stack there; each quarter smelts its whole stack at once, 10 seconds per item. Don't stand on it.
jei.resonantinduction.casting_mold: Pour molten metal on it (a pool sitting on top, or pipes) and it casts ingots, 100 mB each. Click it to take them, or put a hopper under it.
message.resonantinduction.grate.fill_ove: Grate now fills higher than itself
message.resonantinduction.grate.no_fill_: Grate now fills no higher than itself
jei.resonantinduction.gutter: Holds a bucket. Fluid runs down through gutters into whatever is below them, draws from whatever is above, and levels out along connected gutters. Once a second a gutter drinks a fluid block or pool sitting in it, and it fills with rain. Buckets fill and empty the whole run. Right-click with dirty dust to wash it by hand (slow); a Firebox underneath boils the water off.
jei.resonantinduction.tank: Holds sixteen buckets. Tanks that touch share their fluid, filling from the bottom up. Sneak-use with an empty hand to pick it up with its fluid. A comparator reads how full it is.
jei.resonantinduction.grate: Pumped into (with a Pump and pipes), it fills the space in front of its face with the fluid, lowest first; pumped out of, it drains the body of fluid in front of it. More pressure works more blocks at once. A wrench decides whether it fills higher than itself; sneak + wrench turns it.
jei.resonantinduction.pump: Turn it from any side. It draws fluid in at the back and pushes it out of the front, a bucket a tick for each unit of speed, and pressurises pipes on both ends (by its torque, at least 2).
jei.resonantinduction.ceramic_pipe: Carries 5 mB a tick, up to pressure 5. Pipes move fluid from high pressure to low, and level out between themselves. Dye pipes to keep lines apart: dyed pipes only join pipes of the same colour or undyed ones.
jei.resonantinduction.bronze_pipe: Carries 25 mB a tick, up to pressure 25.
jei.resonantinduction.plastic_pipe: Carries 50 mB a tick, up to pressure 30.
jei.resonantinduction.iron_pipe: Carries 100 mB a tick, up to pressure 50.
jei.resonantinduction.steel_pipe: Carries 100 mB a tick, up to pressure 100.
jei.resonantinduction.fiberglass_pipe: Carries 1000 mB a tick, up to pressure 200.
message.resonantinduction.crate.ore_filt: Ore filter on: takes anything with the same material tag
message.resonantinduction.engineering_ta: Engineering Table now takes from neighbouring inventories
Engineering Table now only uses its own grid
jei.resonantinduction.crate_wood: Holds 32 stacks of one item (iron: 64, steel: 256). Right-click to put the held stack in (double-click: all you carry), left-click to take a stack (sneak: one; double-click: everything). Sneak-right-click with an item to lock the crate to it. Wrench: next item with the same material tag; wrench left-click: ore filter; sneak + wrench: pick up the crate with its contents.
jei.resonantinduction.engineering_table: A crafting grid you lay items on: right-click a square of the top. Right-click a side to craft (sneak: as many as you can). The grid is a pattern: ingredients come from chests beside the table and your inventory first. An Imprint in the centre crafts the items on it from those stores. Hit ores on it with a Hammer to crush them.
jei.resonantinduction.hammer: Hit ores laid on an Engineering Table to crush them into rubble (one blow in five works).
jei.resonantinduction.imprinter: Lay items on its top and put an Imprint in its side, then push a piston onto it: each item is added to the imprint's list, or taken off if it was already there.
jei.resonantinduction.turntable: Powered by redstone, it keeps turning the block on its face a quarter turn every quarter second.
message.resonantinduction.placer.pull_of: Placer no longer pulls from behind
jei.resonantinduction.conveyor_belt: Carries whatever is on it along; a redstone signal stops it. Sneak near it to pick items off. Wrench turns it; sneak + wrench makes it slant up, slant down or raised.
jei.resonantinduction.manipulator: Taking in, it stores items that come onto it in the inventory above, below or behind it. Putting out, on a redstone pulse (or by itself: sneak-use it), it takes an item from those inventories and drops it in front. Give it an Imprint to choose the items. Sneak + wrench steps through its modes.
jei.resonantinduction.detector: Gives a redstone signal while items are in front of it. With an Imprint, only those items count; a wrench inverts that.
jei.resonantinduction.sorter: Put an Imprint on any of its faces. Items dropped on it (or put in by hoppers) leave through a face whose imprint lists them, into an inventory there or onto the ground. A wrench inverts every face.
jei.resonantinduction.breaker: On a redstone signal it breaks the block in front of it, putting the drops in an inventory behind it or dropping them there.
jei.resonantinduction.placer: Holds a stack; on a redstone signal it places a block of it in front. Sneak + wrench: it refills from the inventory behind it.
death.attack.resonantinduction.radiation: %1$s died of radiation sickness while fighting %2$s
jei.resonantinduction.uranium_ore: A precious ore used for fission reactions. Found deep underground. It is radioactive: standing on or near it gives radiation.
jei.resonantinduction.radioactive_waste: Gives off harmful radiation and spreads over grass and dirt.
jei.resonantinduction.uranium: Enriched uranium, refined from uranium hexafluoride in a Centrifuge. The fuel in fissile fuel rods.
jei.resonantinduction.uranium_238: Breeding uranium, refined from uranium hexafluoride in a Centrifuge. The fuel in breeder fuel rods.
jei.resonantinduction.yellowcake: Uranium ore extracted in a Chemical Extractor. Boil it into uranium hexafluoride in a Nuclear Boiler.
jei.resonantinduction.fissile_fuel_rod: The primary fuel for fission reactors: put it in a Reactor Cell.
jei.resonantinduction.breeder_fuel_rod: Re-breeds decayed fissile fuel when burnt in a reactor.
jei.resonantinduction.hazmat_mask: Wear the whole hazmat suit to be safe from radiation.
jei.resonantinduction.antimatter: Made in a Particle Accelerator. Dropped on the ground it annihilates after eight seconds, violently. Powers the Fulmination Generator.
